text.Стефанов НП | Шипка, бял трън и лавандул: Stefanov NP | Rosehip, hawthorn and lavender from Bulair and the Varna region
From land with history, farmed with care for nature. Rosehip, hawthorn and lavender from Bulair, near the Haemus Gates, and from the Varna region. Wholesale, with full specifications. Request a quote.
text.В подножието на Източна Стара планина, к: At the foot of the Eastern Balkan Mountains, near the village of Bulair, history and nature meet.
text.Недалеч от нашите насаждения се намират: Not far from our plantations stand the Haemus Gates: an ancient defensive system that guarded the roads across the Balkan range for centuries. Here we grow rosehip and hawthorn, and in the Varna region also lavender, with respect for the land. For us, quality starts in the field.

text.На мястото на централната крепост са отк: Traces of temporary timber structures, older than the stone fort, were found on the site of the central fortress. The name comes from Haemus, the ancient name of the Balkan Mountains: portae Haemi.
text.Три крепости, свързани с преградна стена: Three fortresses joined by a barrier wall about 2.3 km long guard the pass. The central one is known as Harmana. The exact dating of the separate phases is still debated.
text.Братята Карел и Херман Шкорпил описват о: The brothers Karel and Hermann Škorpil describe the remains at the Germeto site, between Bulair and Golitsa.
text.Разкопките през 2005, 2007 и 2009 г. дав: Excavations in 2005, 2007 and 2009 gave a clearer picture of how the walls were built. Today the ruins show the skill of their builders, and the land around them is home to our plantations.

text.Булаир е село в Източна Стара планина, ю: Bulair is a village in the Eastern Balkan Mountains, southwest of Varna. Here the fields border broadleaf forest, grassland and scrub.
text.Землището на Булаир попада в две защитен: The land of Bulair lies within two protected sites of the European Natura 2000 network: BG0000133 Kamchiyska i Emenska planina for habitats and BG0002044 Kamchiyska planina for wild birds. The third, BG0002045 Kompleks Kamchia, lies in the wider Kamchia area.
